scope: Read-only export-offline-bundle.sh and Docker COPY review
Current source allow/deny inventory and credential-marker scan without displaying values
Current VM model manifest/license path inventory only; no weight hashing or runtime load
not_performed: No export/archive construction during CPU window
No archive extraction or Docker load acceptance
No blanket secret scanning guarantee, legal opinion or OS-license audit

source.future_denylist_limit: Root follow-up exporter now excludes .sqlite/.sqlite3/.dump/.pem/.key, SQLite sidecars and backups/private/private-backup directories. Final verifier independently scans archive paths, SQLite magic, private-key markers and long literal credential assignments.

images.frozen_tag_requirement: Root follow-up exporter captures Docker inspect IDs before save and compares IDs after save; changed tags abort export. Verifier additionally checks nine canonical saved tag→config-contentSHA mappings.

models.safe_repair: Add model-root external licenses/{embedder,reranker} sidecars with repository, pinned revision, upstream declaration and full license text. Do not rewrite active model manifests or rerun installer over active artifacts.

required_transfer_acceptance_checks: Generate into a private directory outside live source; maintain umask077 and frozen source/image tags.
Verify each archive size and SHA256 against bundle manifest before extraction. An unsigned manifest protects transfer integrity relative to the trusted copy, not independently its origin.
List archive members first; reject absolute/traversing paths, unexpected links or device files before extracting into empty dedicated directories.
After docker load, compare all nine tags to recorded image IDs and confirm Linux amd64; use --no-build --pull never.

Recursively verify each model manifest, including nested Docling directories: relative contained regular paths, sizes and SHA256; include license/declaration sidecars and current source-bound quality report.
Provision fresh secrets separately; never copy production .env, credentials, volumes or database dumps into the fresh-install source bundle.
Keep internal supplied examples/QA reports restricted; remove them in a separate intentionally sanitized public distribution.
Perform isolated no-egress restore/first start and native profile checks with no MAX credential before corporate deployment; MAX network access is independently permitted.
operator_prep_mutation: Only new license sidecars under model root; all active5filemodel directories and manifest fingerprints unchanged before/after

final_bundle_verifier.runtime_actions: No extract, Docker load, network, model call or server work
final_bundle_verifier.format_compatibility: Explicit requested_tag canonical9mapping; inspect-only aliases may be unsaved. Classic configs and OCI sha256 config blobs/compressed layer blobs are covered by synthetic fixtures.
final_bundle_verifier.layer_scope: Archive integrity, referenced layers and OCI compressed blob digests; not docker load or uncompressed diff_id replay.
